pairing.title: Pair this till
pairing.intro: Ask an admin for a pairing code under Settings, Devices. The code works once and expires after 15 minutes.
pairing.codeHelp: 8 letters and digits. There is no 0, O, 1, I or L.
pairing.name: Till name
pairing.nameHelp: Admins see this name in the device list.
pairing.pairedNoLocation: This till is paired. Its location appears after the first sync.

errors.invalid_code: This pairing code is not valid or has expired. Ask an admin for a new code.
errors.name_required: Enter a name for this till.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then enter the code again.
errors.offline: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection, then try again.
errors.failed: Pairing did not work. Try again, or ask an admin for a new code.

pairing.unsent_one: {{count}} record from this till’s earlier pairing was not uploaded. It is kept for review; ask an admin to pair the till as its former device to send it.
pairing.unsent_other: {{count}} records from this till’s earlier pairing were not uploaded. They are kept for review; ask an admin to pair the till as its former device to send them.

signIn.title: Who is selling?
signIn.subtitle: Choose your name, then enter your PIN.
signIn.empty: No staff can sign in at this till yet. Ask an admin to give staff a role at this location, then sync.

errors.incorrect_one: Wrong PIN. {{count}} try left before this PIN locks on this till.
errors.incorrect_other: Wrong PIN. {{count}} tries left before this PIN locks on this till.
errors.locked: This PIN is locked on this till after 5 wrong tries. Set a new PIN in the back office, or ask a manager to reset it.
errors.not_set: You have no PIN yet. Set one in the back office under your profile.
errors.not_staff: You cannot sign in at this till. Ask an admin to give you a role at this location.
errors.online_required: Your PIN can only be checked online. Connect the till, then try again.
errors.access_lost: This till has lost access. Ask an admin to check the device.
errors.failed: Sign-in did not work. Try again.

clockIn.title: Clock in or out
clockIn.subtitle: Choose your name, then enter your clock-in PIN.
clockIn.empty: No one clocks in at this till yet. Ask HR to set clock-in PINs for staff at this location, then sync.

errors.incorrect_one: Wrong PIN. {{count}} try left before clock-in locks for you on this till.
errors.incorrect_other: Wrong PIN. {{count}} tries left before clock-in locks for you on this till.
errors.locked: Clock-in is locked for you on this till after 5 wrong PINs. Ask HR to set a new clock-in PIN, then sync the till.
errors.not_set: You have no clock-in PIN on this till. Ask HR to set one, then sync the till.
errors.unsupported: This till cannot check your clock-in PIN. Update the app, then try again.
errors.no_secret: This till cannot check clock-in PINs until it syncs. Connect it, then sync.
errors.not_found: You are no longer on this till's clock-in list. Ask HR to check your clock-in settings.
errors.failed: Clock-in did not work. Try again.

changePin.title: Choose a new PIN
changePin.intro: Your PIN was reset. Choose a new one before you sell.
changePin.rules: 4 to 6 digits. Managers who approve need 6. Avoid 1234, 0000 and dates.
changePin.mismatch: The two PINs differ. Enter the new PIN again.
changePin.offline: Changing a PIN needs a connection. You can sell now; you will be asked again when the till is online.
changePin.failed: The PIN was not changed. Try again.

home.failed_one: {{count}} record was refused by the server and needs review.
home.failed_other: {{count}} records were refused by the server and need review.
home.accessLost: The device was unpaired or suspended. Unsent sales stay on this till. Ask an admin to resume the device, then try again.
home.secretMissing: This till has no offline sign-in key. Staff can sign in online only until the till is paired again.
home.pinChangeOffline: Choose a new PIN when the till is back online.
home.moduleInactive: The POS module is not active for your business. Sales stay on this till and upload once it is active again.
home.subscriptionStopped: The subscription is overdue, so this till can no longer send sales. They stay on this till and upload once the owner pays the open invoice in Settings, Subscription.

search.label: Search products
search.none: No products match. Try another name or code.
search.emptyCatalogue: No products on this till yet. Sync, or add items in the back office.
search.unknown: No product has the code {{code}}. Check the code, or search by name.

unsellable.lot_short: Not enough in date stock. Choose another batch or reduce the quantity.
unsellable.buyer_needed: Choose the customer who is buying

sale.title: Current sale
sale.empty: Tap a product or scan a barcode to start a sale.
sale.blocked: Some items cannot be sold until their tax rate is set in the back office. Remove them to charge.
sale.discountCleared: The discount was removed: it is above what you may give at this quantity. Ask a manager to give it again.
sale.paymentLocked: Mobile money was sent for this sale, so its items and customer cannot change. Complete the sale, or refund the payment first.
sale.mobilePaid: The customer has already paid by mobile money. Complete the sale; any money owed goes back through a refund afterwards.
sale.sellingPaused: Selling is paused until the subscription is paid. Ask the Owner to pay the invoice.

offline.note: Offline: sales are recorded on this till and uploaded when you reconnect.
offline.noteKe: Offline: cash and M-Pesa till payments are recorded and sent to KRA eTIMS when you reconnect.
offline.noteCd: Offline: sales are recorded and sent to the DGI when you reconnect.

line.discountHelp: A discount above your limit needs a manager.

errors.qty: Enter a quantity above 0, with at most 6 decimals.
errors.price: Enter the unit price as an amount.
errors.discount: The discount must be an amount no higher than the line price.

customer.title: Customer
customer.none: No customer matches. Check the spelling or the number.

held.title: Held sales
held.none: No held sales on this till.

override.title: Manager approval

why.discount: This discount is above your limit. A manager approves it with their PIN.
why.price: Changing the price needs a manager. A manager approves it with their PIN.
why.void: Voiding a sale needs a manager. A manager approves it with their PIN.
why.refund: This refund needs a manager. A manager approves it with their PIN.
why.pay_out: Paying cash out needs a manager. A manager approves it with their PIN.
why.pay_in: Paying cash in needs a manager. A manager approves it with their PIN.
why.void_line: Voiding an item after it was sent needs a manager. A manager approves it with their PIN.
why.dispense: Selling this needs a pharmacist. A pharmacist approves it with their PIN.

override.nobody: No one at this till can approve this. Ask an admin to give a manager a role here, then sync.
override.noSecret: This till cannot sign approvals without its offline key. Pair the till again.

pay.title: Payment
pay.none: No payments yet. Choose a payment method.
pay.mobileManual: The customer pays to the till number. Type the code from the confirmation message; it is checked when the till syncs.

stk.checkingTitle: Request sent to the customer’s phone
stk.checking: The customer confirms with their PIN. The payment adds itself once confirmed.
stk.failed: The customer did not confirm, or M-Pesa refused the payment. Send the request again, or type the code from their message.

pay.noMethods: No payment methods for this company yet. Add them in the back office, then sync.

errors.mobileCode: Type the M-Pesa code from the customer’s message: 8 to 12 letters and digits.
errors.rate_unavailable: There is no exchange rate for this currency. Take payment in the sale currency, or sync for today’s rates.
errors.sale_underpaid: The payments do not cover the total yet.
errors.no_receipt_numbers: This till has no receipt numbers left. Connect to the internet so the server can give it more, then complete the sale.
errors.lines_blocked: Some items cannot be sold until their tax rate is set. Remove them, then charge.
errors.failed: The sale was not saved. Try again.
errors.push: Enter the customer’s phone number and an amount above 0.
errors.pushFailed: The payment request was not sent. Try again, or type the code from the customer’s message.
errors.codeRefused: This M-Pesa code cannot be used. Check the code in the customer’s message.
errors.receipt_used: This M-Pesa code already paid another sale. Check the code in the customer’s message.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many payment requests. Wait a minute, then send it again.
errors.not_staff_here: You cannot take payments at this till. Ask an admin to give you a role at this location.
errors.sale_exists: This sale is already recorded. Start a new sale.

receipt.fiscalPendingHelp: The authority’s code and QR code are added once the sale reaches the server and the authority accepts it.

fiscalState.waitingHelp: The sale is on this till. It is sent to the server, then to the authority, when the till is online.
fiscalState.rejectedHelp: The back office has the authority’s answer and follows up. The sale stands.
fiscalState.offHelp: This business does not send sales to the tax authority from the platform yet.

shift.openIntro: {{name}}, count the cash in the drawer before you start.
shift.closeIntro: Count the cash in the drawer per currency. Expected cash is shown after you close.
shift.heldWarning_one: {{count}} held sale stays on this till and is not part of this shift.
shift.heldWarning_other: {{count}} held sales stay on this till and are not part of this shift.
shift.serverRecounts: The server recounts expected cash from the records it accepts; the back office shows the final figures.

errors.amount: Enter the {{currency}} amount as a number.
errors.failed: The shift was not saved. Try again.

errors.incomplete: Enter an amount above 0 and a reason.
errors.failed: The cash movement was not saved. Try again.

sales.title: Sales and returns
sales.notFound: No sale on this till has that receipt number. Check the number on the receipt.
sales.none: No sales on this till yet.
sales.pickLines: Choose the items the customer brings back, or void the whole sale.

errors.refundIncomplete: Choose the items, a way to pay back and a reason.
errors.refund_currency: This refund cannot be paid in that currency at the sale’s rate. Choose the sale currency.
errors.refund_qty_exceeded: More than was sold would be returned. Lower the quantity.
errors.refund_empty: Choose at least one item to return.
errors.sale_has_refunds: Items of this sale were returned, so it cannot be voided. Return the rest instead.
errors.void_other_shift: Only sales of the open shift can be voided. Return the items instead.
errors.no_receipt_numbers: This till has no refund numbers left. Connect to the internet so the server can give it more.
errors.record_exists: This refund is already recorded. Find the sale again to see it.

scan.title: Scan barcodes
scan.open: Scan a barcode with the camera
scan.permission: The till needs the camera to scan barcodes. Nothing is recorded or sent.
scan.added: Added {{code}}. Scan the next item, or close.

display.title: Customer display
display.waiting: Waiting for the till. Keep the till open in another tab.
display.closePin: {{name}}, type your PIN to close the customer display.
display.closeNobody: Sign in on the till first. Only a signed-in staff member can close the customer display.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.help: Choose how this till looks. The choice stays on this device.

errors.failed: This payment could not be added. Check it and try again.
errors.loyalty_inactive: The loyalty programme is off. Choose another payment method.
errors.customer_required: Add the customer to the sale first.
errors.points_currency: Points pay in {{currency}}. Choose that currency.
errors.points_invalid: Type the number of points to redeem.
errors.points_below_minimum: At least {{minimum}} points must be redeemed at once.
errors.points_insufficient: The customer has {{available}} points left. Redeem fewer points.
errors.gift_card_unknown: This gift card is not known here. Check the code.
errors.gift_card_inactive: This gift card has not been sold yet. Sell it before using it.
errors.gift_card_blocked: This gift card is blocked. Choose another payment method.
errors.gift_card_expired: This gift card has expired. Choose another payment method.
errors.gift_card_currency: This card pays in {{currency}}. Choose that currency.
errors.gift_card_empty: This gift card has nothing left on it.
errors.credit_not_permitted: You are not allowed to sell on credit. Ask a manager.
errors.credit_no_account: This customer has no open credit account. Choose another payment method.
errors.credit_currency: This customer’s credit is in {{currency}}. Choose that currency.
errors.credit_limit_exceeded: This takes the customer over their credit limit. {{amount}} is left on it.
errors.module_inactive: Room charging is not available. Choose another payment method.
errors.room_unknown: This room is not known here. Check the room number.
errors.not_in_house: No guest is checked in to this room. Check the number or choose another payment method.
errors.folio_settled: This guest’s account is closed to charges. Choose another payment method.
errors.currency_mismatch: This room is billed in {{currency}}. Choose that currency.
errors.limit_exceeded: This takes the room over its charge limit. {{amount}} is left on it.
errors.fuel_voucher_code_required: Type or scan the voucher code.
errors.fuel_voucher_inactive: Fuel vouchers are not available on this till. Choose another payment method.
errors.fuel_voucher_not_permitted: You are not allowed to redeem fuel vouchers. Ask a supervisor.
errors.fuel_voucher_unknown: This voucher is not known here. Check the code or choose another payment method.
errors.fuel_voucher_expired: This voucher has expired. Choose another payment method.
errors.fuel_voucher_currency: This voucher is in {{currency}}. Choose that currency.
errors.fuel_voucher_empty: This voucher has nothing left on it. Choose another payment method.

pharmacy.dateHelp: Year-month-day, for example 2026-10-27. Attach a photo in the back office.
pharmacy.approvalNeeded: A pharmacist must approve this sale.

help.waiting: The sale is on this till. It is sent to the server, then to the authority, when the till is online.
help.pending: The authority’s code and QR code are added once the sale reaches the server and the authority accepts it.
help.rejected: The back office has the authority’s answer and follows up. The sale stands.
help.off: This business does not send sales to the tax authority from the platform yet.

rider.title: Deliveries

signIn.title: Sign in as a rider
signIn.intro: Use your own email or phone and password. Your deliveries appear after you sign in.
signIn.introEmail: Use your own email address and password. Text messages aren’t available yet. Your deliveries appear after you sign in.

rider.empty: No deliveries for you right now.
rider.queued: Saved on this phone. It is sent when the connection is back.

delivered.title: Deliver order {{number}}
delivered.codeHelp: Ask the customer for the 6-digit code from their message.
delivered.collectedHelp: Change it only if the customer paid a different amount.
delivered.collectedInvalid: Enter the amount as a number.

photo.help: Take a photo of the parcel handed over at the address.
photo.permission: The camera takes the delivery photo. It is sent only to the shop with this delivery.
photo.ready: Photo ready. It is sent with the delivery.
photo.failed: The photo was not taken. Try again.

failed.title: Could not deliver order {{number}}
failed.reasonHelp: For example: customer not reachable, wrong address.

rejected.title: Order {{number}} was not updated
rejected.failed: The server refused this update. Refresh your deliveries, then try again.
rejected.code_invalid: The delivery code is wrong. Ask the customer for the code again, then confirm the delivery again.
rejected.code_locked: Too many wrong codes. Ask the store to confirm this delivery.
rejected.proof_required: Enter the customer’s delivery code to confirm the delivery.
rejected.delivery_unknown: This delivery is no longer yours. Refresh your deliveries.
rejected.delivery_status_invalid: This delivery has changed. Refresh your deliveries.
rejected.payload_mismatch: This update was already sent with other details. Refresh your deliveries.
rejected.photo_invalid: The photo could not be used. Take a new photo, then confirm the delivery again.

errors.offline: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection, then try again.
errors.invalid_credentials: The email, phone or password is wrong. Check them, then try again.
errors.locked: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.two_factor: Your account uses two-step sign-in, which the rider screen does not support yet. Ask an admin for help.
errors.forbidden: You are not set up as a rider. Ask a manager to add you.
errors.failed: That did not work. Try again.
errors.unverified: Verify your account first, then sign in.
errors.deactivated: Your account is switched off. Ask an admin.

location.title: Share your location during deliveries
location.body: While you have a delivery in progress, this phone sends your position about once a minute. Only the shop’s staff and the customer of that order see it, and it is cleared when the delivery ends. Nothing is sent when you have no delivery or the app is not open.
location.off: Location sharing is off. You can still deliver; the shop and the customer do not see where you are.
location.blocked: Location is turned off for this app in the phone’s settings. You can still deliver.
location.on: Your location is shared while a delivery is in progress.

restaurant.noPermission: You do not have permission to open orders. Ask a manager.

tables.empty: No tables yet. An admin sets up the floor, then sync this till.
tables.noneMine: None of your tables are open. Show all to see the floor.

tabs.name: Tab name
tabs.namePlaceholder: For example, Joe at the bar
tabs.empty: No open tabs. Open a tab to start a round.

order.empty: Nothing ordered yet. Tap an item to add it.
order.heldCourses_one: {{count}} item is held for a later course.
order.heldCourses_other: {{count}} items are held for a later course.

send.nothing: Nothing is waiting for the kitchen. Fire the next course to send held items.
send.noPrinter: No kitchen printer is connected: the ticket is on the kitchen display.

resend.title: Re-send to the kitchen
resend.help: Pick the round to send again. The kitchen gets a new ticket marked re-send; the first stays.

void.title: Void {{name}}
void.help: This item was already sent to the kitchen. Voiding keeps it on the order, marked void, and tells the station. A reason is required.
void.reasonPlaceholder: For example, guest changed their mind
void.reasonRequired: Enter a reason, then void the item.
void.refused: Not approved. The item stays on the order.

transfer.title: Transfer to another waiter
transfer.help: The table or tab moves to the person you pick. The change is recorded.
transfer.nobody: No other staff to pick. Sync this till to refresh the list.

merge.title: Merge into another table
merge.help: Every item moves to the table you pick, and this table is closed into it.
merge.none: No other table is open to merge into.

flags.table_shared: This table is also open on another till. Check with the other waiter before sending.
flags.transfer_unauthorised: The transfer was made without the right to transfer. A manager will review it.

rejected.title: This order is closed
rejected.order_closed: It was paid at another till. The items added here were kept; ring them again as a new order.
rejected.table_unknown: The table no longer exists. The items were kept; ring them again as a new order.
rejected.waiter_unknown: The waiter is no longer on this location. The items were kept; ring them again as a new order.
rejected.other: The server did not accept this order. The items were kept; ring them again as a new order.
rejected.done_one: {{count}} item moved to a new order.
rejected.done_other: {{count}} items moved to a new order.

bill.title: Bill for {{name}}
bill.seatHelp: One bill per seat ({{count}} seats). Items without a seat are shared equally.
bill.seatNeeds: Give items to at least two seats to split by seat.
bill.splitInvalid: This split does not work yet. Put items in at least two groups, with every item in one group.
bill.locked: A part is paid, so the split can no longer change.
bill.paidHelp: Every part of this bill is paid. The table is free again.

problems.order_empty: There is nothing to bill yet.
problems.service_item_missing: The service charge item is not set for this company. Ask an admin to set it, then sync.
problems.tip_item_missing: The tip item is not set for this company. Ask an admin to set it, then sync.
problems.item_unknown: An item on this order is no longer in the catalogue. Sync this till, then try again.

errors.failed: That did not work. Try again; if it keeps failing, sync this till.
errors.table_blocked: This table is blocked. Ask a manager.
errors.order_unknown: This order is no longer on this till. Go back to the tables and sync.
errors.tab_name_required: Enter a name for the tab.
errors.line_not_sent: This item was not sent, so it can be removed without a reason.
errors.order_has_sent: Items were already sent to the kitchen, so the order cannot be cancelled. Void them first.
errors.merge_same: Pick a different table to merge into.
errors.merge_part_paid: A part of this bill is paid, so it cannot be merged.

housekeeping.title: Rooms to clean
housekeeping.empty: You have no rooms to clean right now.

errors.offline: You are offline. Showing the last list. Reconnect to start, finish or change a room.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to update rooms. Ask your manager.
errors.unavailable: Housekeeping is not available. Ask your manager.
errors.failed: That did not go through. Refresh and try again.

notStation.title: This till is not at a fuel station
notStation.body: The server has no station set up for this location. Ask a manager to set it up, then sync the till. Shop items can still be sold.

home.title: Forecourt
home.noShift: No shift is open. Open a shift to start selling fuel.

problems.shift: The server kept a shift for review
problems.reset: The server refused a meter reset request

open.title: Open shift
open.intro: Choose the nozzles in use, type each opening meter reading and choose who works each nozzle.
open.noLastReading: No earlier reading is known for this nozzle.
open.dipsHelp: Dip each tank in cm if you measured it. The litres come from the tank’s chart.

close.title: Close shift
close.intro: Type the closing meter reading of every nozzle, then what each attendant hands in.
close.testsHelp: Litres poured back into the tank. Leave empty if there were none.
close.handedInHelp: Cash counted is required, zero is allowed. Other tenders start from what this till recorded.
close.recordedHelp: From the sales on this till
close.serverDecides: This variance is a preview from this till’s sales. The server recounts and decides.
close.dipsHelp: Dip each tank in cm if you measured it.
close.dipsTaken: {{count}} dips taken during the shift will be sent with the close.
close.amountInvalid: The {{kind}} amount of {{name}} is not a valid amount. Type it again.

sale.title: Sell fuel
sale.roundedHelp: The litres are rounded down to 3 decimals, so the charge can be a little below the amount typed.
sale.cartLocked: A mobile money payment is waiting on the current sale. Complete that sale first.

fleet.noCustomers: No customer found. Check the spelling.
fleet.noVehicles: No vehicle found for this customer. Check the registration or ask a manager to add it.
fleet.blocked: You can still sell. The sale is sent to the manager for review.

dip.title: Tank dip
dip.intro: Measure the tank and type the dip in cm. The litres come from the tank’s chart. The dip is sent when the shift closes.
dip.needShift: Open a shift first. Dips are sent with the shift.

reset.title: Meter reset request
reset.intro: Use this when a meter was replaced or rolled over. A manager approves the request in the back office. Nothing changes until then.
reset.supervisorOnly: Only a supervisor can ask for a meter reset. Ask a supervisor.
reset.sent: A manager approves the reset in the back office. It goes up as soon as the till is online.

errors.failed: Something went wrong. Check what you typed and try again.
errors.not_permitted: You are not allowed to do this. Ask a supervisor.
errors.shift_open: A shift is already open on this till. Close it before opening another.
errors.nozzles_required: No nozzle is selected. Choose at least one nozzle.
errors.attendant_required: A nozzle has no attendant. Choose who works each nozzle.
errors.reading_invalid: Type the meter reading in litres, with up to 3 decimals.
errors.tests_invalid: Type the pump test litres with up to 3 decimals, or leave it empty.
errors.meter_decreased: This reading is lower than the last one ({{last}} L). Check the reading, or ask a supervisor for a meter reset.
errors.nozzle_duplicate: The same nozzle is listed twice. List each nozzle once.
errors.close_incomplete: The shift can’t close yet. Missing: {{missing}}. Enter these and close again.
errors.test_exceeds_litres: The pump tests are more than the litres the meter moved. Check the closing reading and the tests.
errors.no_shift: No fuel shift is open. Open a shift before selling fuel.
errors.dip_invalid: Type the dip in cm, with up to 2 decimals.
errors.dip_out_of_range: This dip is outside the tank’s calibration chart. Check the reading and measure again.
errors.chart_missing: This tank has no calibration chart yet. Ask a manager to add one.
errors.price_missing: This fuel has no price at this station. Ask a manager to set the price.
errors.item_unknown: The fuel item of this nozzle is not on the till. Sync the till and try again.
errors.currency_mismatch: The fuel price is in {{currency}}, not in the sale currency. Ask a manager to check the price.
errors.nozzle_not_on_shift: This nozzle is not on the open shift. Choose a nozzle of the shift.
errors.litres_invalid: Type the litres with up to 3 decimals.
errors.litres_zero: This is too small to pump any fuel. Type a larger number.
errors.reset_not_lower: The reading after a reset cannot be above the reading before it. Check both readings.
errors.reason_required: Type the reason for the reset.

day.startHelp: Choose today's route. You can start without a connection.
day.noneToday: No route is due today. Choose one anyway or start without a route.

day.stale: This day started on an earlier date and is still open. Count the van to close it.

day.rejectedTitle: {{count}} records were refused by the server

errors.run_open: A day is already open. Count the van to close it first.
errors.visit_unknown: This visit was not found. Go back and open the stop again.

errors.actor_unverified: Your sign-in could not be checked. Sign in again while online, then try again.
errors.load_not_released: This load is not released yet.
